entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-10-15
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Intermittent SourceGeneratorItemTests.AddingAGeneratedDocumentUpdatesListCorrectly Automatic failure #86082
  • IDE0330 is not reported when type contains a multi-variable field declaration #86076
  • Language server crashes with stack overflow when two unions reference each other #86075
    18.13
  • Exception in "Convert to regular constructor" on union type #86074

Closed

  • Go To Definition (and span-based tooling) on Razor ~/ asset paths needs source mapping #84945
    18.13
  • `ISymbol.GetAttributes()` can return a default `ImmutableArray` under concurrent access on ARM64 #85950
    18.13
  • [Known Build Error] TestMultiFile_EditTransitiveDirective fails with ArgumentException: Type provided must be an Enum #86051
  • [Automated] PRs inserted in VS build main-12314.134 #86070

PullRequests

Created

  • keep #! together when formatting a file based app with tabs #86085
    Community, VSCode
  • don't throw when a conflicting linked file change ends inside a line break #86084
    Community, VSCode
  • don't repeat the word separator in generated names #86083
    Community, VSCode
  • Fix missing documentation warnings with inheritdoc #86081
    Community
  • Update FBA sources. Add --sdk-branch script param. #86080
    VSCode
  • Delay check for an ability to convert a Union case type to object #86079
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Unions
  • Compiler caching: add a simpler way to opt in #86078
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Caching Compiler
  • Fix IDE0330 not reported when type contains multi-declarator fields #86077
    Community, VSCode
  • Directly invoke ProjectData writer within CoreCompile target #86073

Merged

  • Fix symbol-completion publication races #85972
    Next
  • Allow Go To Def from a file path in Razor in more places #86072
    Area-Razor, Next
  • Create a skill for analyzing memory dumps #86035
    Next
  • Fix DiagnosticDescription formatting for integer codes and stabilize TestMultiFile_EditTransitiveDirective #86029
    VSCode, Next
  • Simplify RunTests Windows process discovery and log dump stages #86068
    Next
  • [15.9] Backport dotnet-core-internal-tooling WIF authentication (#84414) #86069
    Community

Updated

  • Implement OnDemand Project Loading #85805
    VSCode, Area-Razor
  • Fix compilation caching across filtered generator runs #85935
    Area-Compilers, Community, Feature - Source Generators, VSCode
  • Restore metadata and analyzer references for cached projects #86049
    VSCode
  • Also filter out methods hidden by non-browsable methods in completion #85968
    Area-IDE, Community, VSCode
  • Reduce accessibility for synthesized static local functions #86044
    Community
  • Localized file check-in by OneLocBuild Task: Build definition ID 327: Build ID 3106800 #86046
    Area-Razor
  • Indent list pattern contents relative to '[' when it starts its own line #85997
    Area-IDE, Community, VSCode
  • Handle stackalloc syntax in RemoveUnusedMembers analysis #86016
    Area-IDE, Community, VSCode
  • Set union values state as not-null when constructor invocation uses expanded form #86063
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Unions
  • [release/insiders] Fix analyzer collision in bootstrap leg #85987
    VSCode
  • RoslynTools: handle snap commits #85843
  • Onboard build failure analysis workflow #85046
    Area-Infrastructure, Community
  • Migrate C# and Visual Basic options to Unified Settings #86026
    VSCode
  • Delete TEMP redirection #86038
  • Enforce BOM configuration in CI #85810
    VSCode, Area-Razor
  • Unify ref safety analysis of embedded vs block statements #86019
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Ref Locals and Returns
  • Add tests for ref returning function pointers #85949
  • Scope compiler server mutexes per-user #86056
    Area-Compilers
  • Keep tuple element names when nullable analysis re-infers a call with a tuple literal argument #85976
    Area-Compilers, Community
